description: Generated by go generate ./internal/config from the struct tree; do not edit.

import_task_keep.description: How long an import task of a publish stays readable; the daily task ansible-import-task-sweep deletes older ones and keeps the versions they describe (R-ANS-009). It stays far above the longest wait of a client, which retries a task that answers 404 until its own timeout.

max_archive_bytes.description: Largest collection archive a publish or an upload through /files/ accepts; a larger body is refused with 413 payload_too_large before it is read when its length is declared, and while it is read otherwise (R-ANS-008, R-ANS-031). The upload limit of the system and of the repository (R-STOR-004) applies as well.

role_archive_max_bytes.description: Largest role archive a remote repository fetches from the host of a role's version and keeps (R-ANS-020, R-ANS-031).

allowed_origins.description: Exact origins (scheme://host[:port]), no wildcards. Empty: CORS is off and no Access-Control-Allow-* header is sent.

idempotency_retention.description: How long the outcome of an Idempotency-Key is replayed (R-API-014).

max_request_body_bytes.description: Largest JSON request body of /api/v1/; larger answers 413 (R-API-017).

page_size_default.description: limit of a list request that sends none (R-API-010).

page_size_max.description: Largest limit; a larger one is clamped to it (R-API-010).

exempt_admins.description: Callers who hold the admin capability bypass the limits.

burst.description: Most writes one window admits: a registry push sends three per blob, an image has at most 127 layers per platform, and the default holds four platforms.

requests_per_second.description: Sustained rate; the window is burst divided by this, at least 1s.

check_interval.description: How often a replica of role api (or web, all) looks at the password file for a rotation.

enabled.description: The one local account; disable it once an OIDC administrator exists.

password_file.description: Argon2id PHC hash or plaintext password; read by the replicas of role api (and by the development roles web and all) only (R-AUTH-042).

rotation_hold.description: Local login is refused this long after a password rotation was noticed (Q-AUTH-14).

enabled.description: Off breaks NuGet restore, _auth users and every OCI registry client (Docker, Podman, containerd: the token service takes the Quader token as Basic or as the password of the OAuth 2.0 form, Q-OCI-57); Basic with a password is impossible regardless.

nuget_api_key_header.description: Examine X-NuGet-ApiKey on the routes that declare the API key: NuGet push, delete, relist (R-AUTH-033).

auto_redirect.description: Redirect the login page to the provider when exactly one is configured.

providers.description: Login providers by ID; see R-AUTH-004. Keys of an entry that are left out take the defaults of R-AUTH-004, R-AUTH-007 and R-AUTH-008.

device_code_failures.description: Wrong device user codes per user within auth.cli_login.ttl, cluster-wide.

exempt_cidrs.description: Client addresses or CIDRs that are never throttled.

failures_per_address.description: Rejected credentials per minute and client address, cluster-wide; a per-replica share while Valkey is unavailable.

recent_token_window.description: Throttle exemption of a credential validated on any replica.

starts_per_address.description: Requests to the unauthenticated row-creating endpoints per minute and address, cluster-wide.

revocation_bound.description: Revocation bound; at least 2 x cluster.epoch_poll_interval.

absolute_timeout.description: Ends a session this long after its creation.

idle_timeout.description: Ends a session this long after its last request (R-AUTH-010).

max_per_user.description: Concurrent sessions of one user; one more ends the oldest.

recent_auth_window.description: Credential-minting actions need an interactive authentication this recent (R-AUTH-011).

default_ttl.description: Lifetime of a Bastion token when the request names none: one year (R-BAS-004).

max_ttl.description: Ceiling of a Bastion token's lifetime: one year and a month, so a yearly renewal fits its overlap (R-BAS-004).

cache_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the four auth caches; bounds staleness only if an invalidation were lost.

max_ttl.description: Hard ceiling; the CI exchange sets the issued lifetime.

expiry_notice.description: A token expiring within this period produces one token.expiring event; runtime-adjustable.

last_used_granularity.description: A token's last-used time is written at most once per this period, however often and on however many replicas the token is used.

bst.description: Unrevoked Bastion tokens per registration, so that a renewal's overlap fits (R-BAS-004).

max_technical_tokens_per_account.description: Technical tokens of one service account, ended ones included (R-AUTH-045); those with a live secret are bounded by max_active_per_principal.sat.

allowed_groups.description: Empty: every user may create personal tokens; otherwise only members of these groups (R-AUTH-017).

max_ttl.description: Ceiling for the runtime setting; at most 876000h (100 years), the largest maximum the revocation journal replays (R-AUTH-041).

retention_after_end.description: The token-cleanup task deletes a token row this long after expiry or revocation.

allow_non_expiring.description: Lets an administrator create a service-account token without expiry.

max_ttl.description: Ceiling for the runtime setting; at most 876000h (100 years), the largest maximum the revocation journal replays (R-AUTH-041).

reads.description: Which reads are audited: none, denied (refused reads) or all (allowed reads too; the volume follows the downloads, Q-AUTHZ-5).

max_staleness.description: No decision is made on a grant index that was not confirmed current for longer; a request waits for a confirmation, then is answered 503 authz_stale (Q-AUTHZ-13). At least three times cluster.epoch_poll_interval; start-up refuses a lower value.

safety_ttl.description: Full rebuild of the grant index at least this often, jittered by up to 10 percent; it bounds a write path that changed an input without notifying.

hide_existence.description: A refused read answers 404, indistinguishable from a missing resource (R-AUTHZ-016, R-AUTHZ-017); false answers 403 for a resource that exists, for troubleshooting only. A repository's hideExistence overrides it.

role_bindings.description: System role bindings declared here (R-AUTHZ-010, Q-AUTHZ-170): quader migrate applies them with source configuration and removes the configuration bindings no longer listed; the API and the UI show them read-only. Each entry names role and exactly one of group, user and service_account. Whoever controls the membership of a declared IdP group holds the role.

group.description: A group; one that does not exist is created as a local group, which the login provider's group sync then fills (R-AUTH-008).

role.description: A system role: admin, security-admin, auditor, repository-admin or webhook-admin.

service_account.description: A service account; one that does not exist stops quader migrate.

user.description: A user; one that does not exist stops quader migrate.

compression_level.description: zstd level of table files and the blob list.

bytes_per_second.description: Transfer rate cap per run; 0 is unlimited.

part_size.description: Raised so that an object fits 10,000 parts.

lock_timeout.description: Wait for the table locks of the snapshot.

migration_wait.description: Wait for a running migration's lock.

parallel.description: Export connections besides the snapshot connection.

part_size.description: Multipart part size of table files.

remote_caches.description: Leave out blobs that only remote-repository caches reference.

expected_interval.description: How often a backup is expected. QuaderBackupStale and the overdue mark of the API and the UI fire after 1.5 times this value (R-BAK-014).

finalize_timeout.description: Request deadline of the manifest write; twice this value must stay below lease_duration (R-BAK-010).

object_versioning.description: Asserts that the blob bucket is versioned and keeps noncurrent versions for at least recovery_window (R-HA-023).

recovery_window.description: The point-in-time recovery window the platform keeps (R-HA-023); 0s is undeclared. The task backup-check verifies it and a replica refuses to start when it exceeds storage.gc.grace_period without object_versioning (R-HA-024).

sweep_interval.description: A full pool sweep at least this often.

run_history.description: backup_run rows older than this are deleted by the next run.

connections.description: The read credential of a connection, one element per connection at most (R-BAK-030); a connection without one is read with its own credential. In the environment the whole list is one JSON value (QUADER_BACKUP_SOURCE_CONNECTIONS).

connection.description: The id of the connection of storage.connections the credential reads.

stall_timeout.description: A run without progress for this long cancels itself and exits 75 (R-BAK-013).

allow_same_bucket.description: Allows the target on the blob store's endpoint and bucket, for single-bucket evaluation setups; the prefixes still must not contain each other (R-BAK-002).

ca_file.description: Empty means the system trust store.

endpoint.description: Empty means AWS endpoint resolution for the region. A host without a scheme means https://.

verify_sample.description: Pool objects HEAD-checked before each manifest.

max_repositories.description: Repository keys one check may ask about (R-BAS-011).

declared.description: Bastion registrations the configuration declares, keyed by the registration's name (R-BAS-127). Each entry names description, egress (the networks the Bastion connects from, CIDR or single addresses) and token_file, the absolute path of a file that holds the Bastion's token (qdr_bst_, 57 characters, the value the Bastion's chart reads from mainToken.existingSecret), and secret_name, the Kubernetes Secret the admin page names. quader migrate applies the map on every run, also on a fresh database: it creates a missing registration, makes its description, networks and token follow the entry, replaces the token when the file holds another value, and of a registration no longer declared revokes the token it had declared and keeps the rest. Only migrate reads the file; a value that is not a Bastion token stops migrate with the name. Limits, presets, switches and tokens issued on the screen stay an administrator's. In the chart, bastions.declared renders this map. As an environment variable the map is JSON, for example QUADER_BASTIONS_DECLARED='{"partners":{"egress":["198.51.100.0/28"],"token_file":"/run/secrets/partners/token"}}'.

events_burst.description: Download events one window of the limiter admits; at least max_batch, so that every batch can fit (R-BAS-016). Charged in units of 100 events.

events_per_second.description: Download events one registration may report per second across the replicas (R-BAS-016); a batch beyond the budget is answered 429 with Retry-After and sent again by the Bastion.

max_age.description: An event older than this is not recorded and counts as dropped (R-BAS-016).

max_batch.description: Events one request of the intake accepts (R-BAS-016).

lookback.description: A feed read returns every entry newer than its cursor minus this period, so a transaction that committed late is not missed; longer than any transaction (the replay margin of R-HA-054).

max_page.description: Entries one feed read returns at most (R-BAS-015).

max_registrations.description: Bastion registrations that may exist; also bounds the bastion label of the interface metrics (R-BAS-004).

snapshot_safety_ttl.description: Full reload of the repository snapshot.

unknown_repo_keys.description: Per replica: negative cache of unknown repository keys.

enabled.description: false answers every exchange with 404 and registers no limiter state.

expose_reason.description: false leaves the reason member out of the 400 answers; logs and audit keep it (R-CI-008).

max_body_bytes.description: Largest request body of the exchange.

exempt_cidrs.description: Client addresses or CIDRs that skip the per-address limiter, for example a runner network behind NAT. They stay bounded by server.max_in_flight and the per-subject limiter.

per_client_ip_per_minute.description: Limiter ci_exchange_address: requests per client address and minute, cluster-wide.

per_subject_per_minute.description: Limiter ci_exchange_subject: exchanges per CI issuer and subject (the first pin claim, usually project_id) and minute, cluster-wide.

retention.description: Issuance records whose token expired longer ago than this are deleted by the task ci-issuance-retention. Go durations have no day unit.

issuers.description: CI issuers declared here (R-CI-001, Q-CI-16): quader migrate applies them by name with source configuration, in one transaction, and disables the configuration issuers no longer listed; the API and the UI show them read-only. Each entry carries the fields of the issuer API in snake_case with the same validation and defaults; name, kind and issuer are required.

enabled.description: The CI_JOB_TOKEN fallback is not built (R-CI-022, Q-CI-5); true stops the start.

cache_safety_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the in-process copy of the issuers and their mappings (R-ARCH-018).

max_per_issuer.description: Most mappings of one CI issuer.

max_per_project.description: Most mappings of one project's tier on one CI issuer, at most max_per_issuer: no project fills the issuer's limit alone (Q-CI-49).

retention_after_expiry.description: How long a recorded jti is kept after the subject token's exp plus the issuer's clock skew; at least 1m, so a replica whose clock lags the database's by less than that never accepts a single-use subject token whose row ci-replay-cleanup deleted (Q-CI-51).

warn_after_exchanges.description: From this exchange count of one subject token on, every further exchange of an issuer without single use records ci.exchange.repeated.

cache_safety_ttl.description: SafetyTTL of the in-process copy of the key sets (R-ARCH-018).

default_refresh_interval.description: Next refresh of a key set whose response carries no Cache-Control max-age.

fetch_timeout.description: Timeout of one discovery or key request.

max_refresh_interval.description: Upper clamp of the refresh interval.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest discovery or key response read.

max_stale.description: Age of the stored key set after which exchanges answer 503 signing_keys_unavailable.

min_refresh_interval.description: Lower clamp of the refresh interval; also the retry delay after a failed fetch.

unknown_kid_refresh_interval.description: At most one on-demand fetch per issuer and replica for a token whose kid is unknown (R-CI-003).

default_ttl.description: Lifetime of a CI token when the request names none.

max_ttl.description: Upper bound of every CI token; at most auth.tokens.cit.max_ttl (R-CI-016).

min_ttl.description: Shortest lifetime worth issuing; a subject token with less left answers subject_token_expires_too_soon.

epoch_max_staleness.description: The invalidation readiness check; at least the readiness window of R-HA-008.

flight_lock_ttl.description: Extended every ttl/3 while the fetch runs.

secrets_dir.description: Directory of the files that a secretRef {"file": name} names; a name is a file directly under it (R-REPO-033, R-OPS-029).

allow_insecure.description: Permits ssl_mode disable, allow and prefer.

control_host.description: Control pooler host; empty means host.

control_name.description: Database entry of the control pooler; empty means name.

host.description: Host name; a comma-separated list is allowed (R-HA-009).

max_conns.description: At least 2: one is the control connection.

expected_serving_replicas.description: The replicas of every Deployment without a lease pool (api, packages and their pools) together. Set by the chart on the migration Job.

expected_web_replicas.description: Deprecated alias of expected_serving_replicas, read while that key is 0 (R-ARCH-025).

expected_worker_replicas.description: Set by the chart on the migration Job.

request_statement_timeout.description: Every database statement of an HTTP request ends after this long and the request answers 503 database_timeout (R-ARCH-019); jobs and loops run under session.statement_timeout. At most session.statement_timeout.

max_elapsed.description: Request deadlines may cut it shorter.

client_connection_check_interval.description: PostgreSQL's client_connection_check_interval: a statement whose client went away ends within it (R-ARCH-019). Through a transaction-mode pooler a role default, like the other session settings.

session_host.description: Direct host for session-scoped connections; empty means host.

by_hash_keep.description: How long the files of a superseded index generation stay served by hash, so a client that read InRelease before a build can still fetch the index files it names (R-DEB-012); at least three generations are kept in any case.

index_delay.description: Time a change of a suite waits before the build of its indexes starts, so a burst of uploads is one build (R-DEB-010). The delay bound of an upload to its published index is this value plus 5 s (jobs.poll_interval more while Valkey is unavailable). At least 1 s, because a Release Date and a signature time trail the database clock by a minute and a build per second is the most a suite can publish (Q-DEB-30).

index_wait_max.description: The longest wait of an index state read with waitFor (R-DEB-014); a longer request answers with the state it has reached.

virtual_index_interval.description: Least time between two builds of a virtual repository's indexes that a local member's publication triggers (R-DEB-026); a change of the members or the settings builds without this delay.

database_outage_grace.description: A replica that was ready stays ready while PostgreSQL has been unreachable for less than this; 0 disables it. Must be below database.retry.max_elapsed.

require_object_store.description: True makes the object store gate readiness continuously.

shutdown_drain_delay.description: Must exceed the edge's endpoint removal time.

watchdog_timeout.description: Bound for the watched loops of liveness.

exclude_queues.description: Queues this worker does not claim; empty: none. Mutually exclusive with queues. As an environment variable the list is written as JSON, for example QUADER_JOBS_EXCLUDE_QUEUES='["index","mirror"]'.

queues.description: Queues this worker claims; empty: every queue. Mutually exclusive with exclude_queues. As an environment variable the list is written as JSON, for example QUADER_JOBS_QUEUES='["index"]'.

retention.description: How long finished jobs are kept.

downloads.description: The runs of the download queues of remote repositories, the job remote-download (remote-curation.md R-CUR-011): a queue of its own, so that downloads ahead of a client never wait behind the default queue's work; each run takes one of its repository's background slots (R-REPO-055).

malware.description: The malware scanning's job and its database task (malware-scanning.md R-MAL-004, R-MAL-010): one job at a time in the installation keeps malware.concurrency calls in flight, so one slot is enough.

mirror.description: The passes of mirrored remote repositories and their dispatch (R-REPO-053).

signatures.description: The jobs of the signatures on artifacts, signature-verify and signature-trust, and the task signature-trust-root (signatures.md R-SIG-011, R-SIG-012, R-SIG-017): a queue of its own, so neither the malware scanning nor the advisory sync waits behind a backlog of signatures; one job keeps signatures.concurrency checks in flight, so one slot is enough.

signing.description: The job signing and its task (signatures.md R-SIG-049): a queue of its own, so that a signature of a publish never waits behind the verification of signatures; one job keeps signing.concurrency operations in flight, so one slot is enough.

flush_interval.description: How often a replica carries the bytes and refused requests it counted to the counters in Valkey (R-LIM-017).

min_bytes_per_second.description: Every download proceeds at least at this rate, whatever its share, so no client's idle timeout fires.

lease.description: How long a transfer's lease of the figure parallelTransfers holds its place without a renewal; a crashed replica's leases end after it.

wait.description: How long a transfer beyond the figure parallelTransfers waits for a free place before it answers 429; 0 answers at once.

flush_interval.description: How often a replica writes its usage buffer to PostgreSQL.

max_buffered_keys.description: Rows a replica's usage buffer holds; beyond, a new key is merged into an overflow row.

summary_retention.description: How long the daily sums without a person are kept (400 days).

ops_listener.description: Also log probe and metrics requests.

redact_query_params.description: Query parameters whose value is redacted in the request path and in logged URLs (R-OPS-010, R-OPS-013).

ring_buffer_bytes.description: Upper bound of the bytes the ring buffer holds; the oldest records go first. A record above 16 KiB is kept as a stub.

concurrency.description: Calls to the malware scanners the one job of the installation has in flight; one of them is kept for blobs a download waits for while any is due (R-MAL-004). The chart's capacity is malwareScanner.replicaCount times scanner.slots (2 x 2); a call above it is put off with scanner_busy.

max_file_size.description: Largest file of a signature database the task reads; a larger one is refused database_invalid (R-MAL-010).

repository.description: With the source repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of the local generic repository an administrator fills (example ops/clamav-db). Whoever holds deploy there decides what the scanners compare content with and what the endpoint of upstream/clamav serves (H-1107). Not read with the source updater.

source.description: Where the database task takes the signature database from: updater, the Deployment malware-updater-freshclam that fetches ClamAV's whole signed containers and that the worker asks every 30 minutes over malware.updater (R-MAL-010); repository, a local generic repository of an own project that an administrator fills by hand with the files of cvdupdate, for an installation without a way to ClamAV's network, where the chart renders no updater and the settings page shows the commands (R-MAL-012).

stale_after.description: A database whose build time is older than this makes the scanning stale: scanning goes on with it, the settings page says so and QuaderMalwareDatabaseStale fires (R-MAL-010).

download_wait.description: How long a download of content that is not checked yet waits for its verdict where the gate is strict, counted from the request's arrival (R-MAL-014, Q-MAL-29); then 503 malware_check_pending with Retry-After. The default keeps the whole answer inside apt's 30-second timeout.

enabled.description: false: no scan, no verdict and no gate: nothing is refused for malware and the stored verdicts stay as they are (R-MAL-001). With the scanning on and the switch Only checked artifacts can be downloaded off (the default), only content found infected is refused.

max_attempts.description: Attempts at a scan that ends for a reason that may pass (blob_missing, timeout, scan_failed, scanner_lost); after the last the blob is failed, refused under the switch, and scanned again once its scan pressure reaches the cycle of the rescan settings (R-MAL-005, R-MAL-037).

max_size.description: Largest blob scanned at all; a larger one is unscannable too_large without a call, refused under the switch until an instance auditor releases it (R-MAL-008). The worker checks it before the call and the malware scanner before it reads.

max_waiting.description: Downloads one replica holds waiting for a verdict; a further one is answered 503 malware_check_pending at once (R-MAL-014).

read_timeout.description: The malware scanner's read of one blob through the scan listener, and the lifetime of its blob token (R-MAL-006). The worker's call has the deadline read_timeout plus scanner.scan_timeout plus 1m.

run_slice.description: How long one job keeps its slot on the queue malware before the rest of the work goes to the next job; a call in flight is finished first (R-MAL-004).

client_name.description: The name the scan listener's malware routes (the blob and the signature database, R-MAL-006) require in a client certificate, listed exactly among its DNS names, so that no other kind of pod the listener admits reads them (Q-MAL-27, Q-MAL-61). It must be one of server.scan_clients when that list is set. Empty: the routes admit whatever the listener admits (the role all, and an installation that has not set it). The chart sets <fullname>-malware-scanner-clamav.<namespace>.svc.

server_name.description: The name the malware scanner and the updater require in the scan listener's certificate, which must chain to server.internal_tls.ca_file and list it exactly among its DNS names (Q-ARCH-552); empty is the host of url. The chart sets <fullname>-packages.<namespace>.svc, the name of packages (R-HA-063).

updater_client_name.description: The name the scan listener's signature database routes admit besides client_name: the updater's, for its seed (R-MAL-032), and the name by which the listener records the updater's report of itself as the kind freshclam (R-OPS-048, Q-OPS-224). The blob route never admits it. It must differ from client_name and be one of server.scan_clients when that list is set. The chart sets <fullname>-malware-updater-freshclam.<namespace>.svc while it renders the updater.

url.description: The scan listener of packages, an origin: https://<fullname>-packages-scan.<namespace>.svc:8082 in the chart, which sets it. Required in a malware scanner and in the updater (the role scanner of the kinds clamav and freshclam); no other role reads it, and the role all builds neither (Q-ARCH-563). Neither reads another address: a call cannot point them elsewhere.

client_name.description: The name the malware scanner's listener requires in a client certificate, listed exactly among its DNS names (Q-ARCH-552): the worker's. Required in a malware scanner while server.tls serves TLS; empty in the role all, where the CA alone admits (Q-ARCH-553). The chart sets <fullname>-worker.<namespace>.svc.

max_entries.description: Entries the malware scanner's own unpacking reads from one blob; content past it is unscannable limits_exceeded (R-MAL-007).

max_file_size.description: Largest part handed to clamd whole, and clamd's MaxFileSize and StreamMaxLength; a larger part that is gzip, xz, zstd or a tar is unpacked by the scanner, any other is unscannable limits_exceeded (R-MAL-007, R-MAL-008). At most 2GiB less one byte: ClamAV scans nothing larger.

max_scan_size.description: clamd's MaxScanSize: what it unpacks of one part; content past it is unscannable limits_exceeded (R-MAL-008). At least max_file_size.

max_uncompressed_size.description: Bytes the malware scanner's own unpacking of ar, zstd and large containers produces from one blob; content past it is unscannable limits_exceeded (R-MAL-007).

scan_timeout.description: clamd's MaxScanTime for one part, and the malware scanner's bound on the work of one call after its read; a call past it ends timeout (R-MAL-008).

server_name.description: The name the worker requires in the malware scanner's certificate, which must chain to server.internal_tls.ca_file and list it exactly among its DNS names, no wildcard standing for it (Q-ARCH-552); empty is the host of url. The chart sets <fullname>-malware-scanner-clamav.<namespace>.svc, the name of the malware scanner's own pair (R-HA-063).

slots.description: Calls one malware scanner runs at a time, and clamd's MaxThreads; a call while every slot holds one is answered 503 scanner_busy. One clamd serves every slot of its pod, so more than one slot lets the artifacts scanned at the same time reach each other through a taken-over clamd (H-1105).

socket.description: The Unix socket of the clamd beside the malware scanner, on the volume the two containers share (R-MAL-007).

url.description: The malware scanner's listener, an origin: https://<fullname>-malware-scanner-clamav.<namespace>.svc:8080 in the chart, which sets it. Empty: the worker's job makes no call and its check malwareScannerClamav reports why (Q-MAL-60); the blobs wait pending.

client_name.description: The name the updater's listener requires in a client certificate, listed exactly among its DNS names (Q-ARCH-552): the worker's. Required in the updater while server.tls serves TLS. The chart sets <fullname>-worker.<namespace>.svc.

directory.description: In the updater: the directory freshclam writes and the updater seeds, lists and serves, the volume its two containers share (R-MAL-032, R-HA-069). Read by the updater only.

server_name.description: The name the worker requires in the updater's certificate, which must chain to server.internal_tls.ca_file and list it exactly among its DNS names (Q-ARCH-552); empty is the host of url. The chart sets <fullname>-malware-updater-freshclam.<namespace>.svc, the name of the updater's own pair (R-HA-063).

url.description: The updater's listener, an origin: https://<fullname>-malware-updater-freshclam.<namespace>.svc:8080 in the chart, which sets it. Empty with the source updater: the database task imports nothing and the check malwareUpdaterFreshclam reports the reason no_updater, which does not gate (Q-MAL-98).

repository_label_include.description: Selectors of an instance context (R-AUTHZ-004), such as web/npm-* or */nuget-*, that give the repositories they match a series of their own before the others; a repository is named by its qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey>, a bare key stops startup (R-OPS-007).

advisory_lock_wait.description: How long to wait for another migrator.

abbreviated_time.description: Add the time map to abbreviated package documents, which pnpm and Yarn need for release-age policies (R-NPM-011).

document_max_age.description: max-age of the Cache-Control header of package documents; 0 makes clients revalidate every time, which a 304 makes cheap (R-NPM-013).

manifest_consistency.description: A request manifest that differs from the tarball's package.json: reject answers 400 npm_manifest_mismatch, warn audits the difference, accepts the publish and stores the request's manifest.

max_tarball_size.description: Largest tarball of a publish; at most storage.upload.max_size.

max_unpacked_size.description: Largest sum of the unpacked entry sizes of a tarball.

retry_window.description: How long a repeated publish of identical bytes is acknowledged as the first one (Q-NPM-11); 0s turns the acknowledgement off.

max_compression_ratio.description: Largest compression ratio of an entry read into memory; at most the 100:1 of R-ARCH-028.

max_entries.description: Most entries the central directory of a package may declare (Q-NUGET-23).

max_nuspec_bytes.description: Largest .nuspec of a package; at most the 1 MiB of R-ARCH-028 (Q-NUGET-25).

max_uncompressed_bytes.description: Largest sum of the declared sizes of all entries of a package (Q-NUGET-23).

inline_below.description: A package with fewer visible versions has every page inlined in its registration index; with more, the pages are fetched from their own URL.

default_take.description: Results of a search that names no take.

max_skip.description: Largest skip; a larger one answers 400.

max_take.description: Largest take; a larger one is clamped.

remote_result_ttl.description: How long the answer of a forwarded search is kept; 0s keeps none. The engine cuts it to one hour (Q-NUGET-16).

virtual_merge_window.description: How many results of each member a search through a virtual repository merges; positions beyond it answer an empty data (R-NUGET-018).

token_lifetime.description: Lifetime of a registry token (R-OCI-005); never beyond the expiry of the Quader token it was issued for. A longer lifetime widens the window in which a leaked registry token is usable while its Quader token stays valid (H-595). Revoking the Quader token or disabling its owner ends its registry tokens within auth.revocation_bound, and every request is decided again on the current grants.

unreferenced_blob_grace.description: Age a blob of an image name must have before the sweep removes it for being referenced by no manifest of the name (R-OCI-019); must exceed storage.uploads.session_max_age, so a blob pushed before its manifest is never taken.

role.description: Role of this replica: api, packages, worker, scanner (a scanning tool's wrapper, the tool chosen by process.scanner_kind, holding no secret of the installation, R-ARCH-036), web (api and packages in one process, development and tests only) or all (local development only). No default.

scanner_kind.description: The tool a process of the role scanner wraps: trivy, the analysis of container images and the detection of their stored analyses with Trivy (R-VULN-041, R-VULN-048); trivy-db, the loader of Trivy's database, the second container of a pod of vuln-scanner-trivy, which reads the database in use through the scan listener into the directory the scanner mounts read-only (R-VULN-049, Q-ARCH-564); clamav, the malware scanner with clamd beside it (malware-scanning.md R-MAL-005 to R-MAL-007); or freshclam, the malware scanning's updater beside ClamAV's freshclam, which seeds, lists and serves freshclam's directory to the worker (R-MAL-032, Q-ARCH-562). The chart runs trivy and trivy-db in the Deployment <fullname>-vuln-scanner-trivy, sets clamav on <fullname>-malware-scanner-clamav and freshclam on <fullname>-malware-updater-freshclam. A scanner of the kind trivy-db reads vulnerabilities.images.registry and vulnerabilities.images.database, one of the kind clamav the section malware instead of vulnerabilities.images, one of the kind freshclam malware.updater and malware.scan_listener. Read by the role scanner only.

blocked_content_types.description: Media types an upstream answer may not have where integrity.blockUnexpectedContentTypes is true (R-REPO-042); lower-case type/subtype without parameters.

cache_bytes.description: Per replica: the parsed pages of the catalogue's answers (names and facts, never a document's bytes); 0 turns the cache off (R-CUR-008).

cache_ttl.description: How long a parsed answer of the catalogue is kept; 0s keeps none (R-CUR-008).

max_document_bytes.description: The largest upstream document the catalogue reads; a larger one answers 502 catalogue_answer_too_large (R-CUR-008).

requests_per_minute.description: Upstream requests of the catalogue per repository and minute across replicas, on the cluster limiter; one more answers 429 catalogue_budget_exhausted (R-CUR-008).

requests_per_minute_per_person.description: Upstream requests of the catalogue per person and minute across repositories and replicas (R-CUR-008).

timeout.description: How long one catalogue call may take before it answers 502 catalogue_answer_too_large (R-CUR-008).

remote_refusal.description: A remote repository refuses a name that a global claim covers, also when addressed directly.

examine_versions_per_request.description: Versions a new request for a package downloads for examination: the newest that are no prereleases (R-CUR-015).

max_client_entries.description: Request entries without an asker per repository; beyond it the entry with the oldest last refusal goes first (R-CUR-015).

max_rules.description: Delivery rules per remote repository, of which at most 100 are sections; one more answers 422 too_many_rules (R-CUR-006). Measured in each replica's snapshot: about 130 bytes a package rule and 185 a version rule of a package of its own, 6.5 to 9.5 MB per repository at 50000, twice that while the snapshot is rebuilt.

open_requests_per_person.description: Open requests for an allow one person may hold in one repository; one more answers 429 too_many_requests (R-CUR-015).

request_retention.description: How long an entry with no asker and no client refusal stays before the retention task removes it (R-CUR-015).

client_failures_per_repository.description: Rows of clients' failed fetches per repository; beyond it the oldest is removed (R-CUR-011, Q-CUR-19).

done_retention.description: How long a done or cancelled row stays after it finished (R-CUR-011).

failed_retention.description: How long a failed row stays after it finished (R-CUR-011).

max_attempts.description: Attempts of a row whose failure a later attempt can overcome (R-CUR-011).

max_bytes_per_bulk.description: The default and the highest value of a bulk's maxBytes, which the person may lower (R-CUR-010).

max_syncs_per_repository.description: Downloads kept in sync per repository; one more answers 422 too_many_syncs (R-CUR-027). Each runs every remote.syncs.intervalSeconds of its repository.

max_versions_per_bulk.description: The default and the highest value of a bulk's maxVersions, which the person may lower (R-CUR-010).

max_waiting_per_repository.description: Waiting rows of one repository; a person's download beyond it answers 429 download_queue_full, a bulk's expansion pauses (R-CUR-011).

per_repository.description: Rows of one repository's queue that run at once; the rest wait (R-CUR-011). Each running row takes one of the repository's background slots (R-REPO-055).

fetch_wait_timeout_seconds.description: How long a request waits for another replica's fetch of the same path; after it the request fetches without the cross-replica lock (R-REPO-026).

global_offline.description: No remote repository contacts its upstream; the runtime switch cannot lift it (R-REPO-031).

lock_poll_interval_ms.description: How long a waiter for a flight lock waits for the outcome message before it checks the lock key again (R-REPO-026 step 4).

max_artifact_bytes.description: System value of limits.maxArtifactBytes: a larger upstream artifact is refused with 502 upstream_item_too_large (R-REPO-040).

max_concurrent_fetches.description: Per replica: upstream fetches in flight over all remote repositories (R-REPO-040).

max_redirects.description: Redirect hops followed per upstream request; one more answers 502 too_many_redirects (R-REPO-039).

merged_metadata_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: merged package documents of virtual repositories (R-REPO-020); 0 turns the cache off.

metadata_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: the bytes of recently served metadata documents of remote repositories by blob digest, so a fresh hit costs no object-store round trip (R-REPO-025); a document above an eighth of it is not kept; 0 turns the cache off.

negative_l1_entries.description: Per replica: entries of the in-process copy of the negative cache of remote repositories (R-REPO-028); about 100 bytes each.

query_cache_bytes.description: Per replica: the answers of pass-through queries to the upstreams of remote repositories, such as a package search (R-ARCH-013 step 6); an answer above the whole budget is not kept; 0 turns the cache off.

queue_timeout_seconds.description: How long a fetch waits for a free slot before it answers 503 with Retry-After: 5; 0 refuses at once (R-REPO-040).

publish_interval.description: How often a replica writes its running downloads from upstreams to PostgreSQL, and how often an open overview reads them again (R-OPS-050, R-OPS-052).

lookup_wait.description: How long a request for a repository key that PostgreSQL knows and the snapshot does not waits for the change-log poll before it answers 503 (R-ARCH-011 step 2).

max_virtual_members.description: The most members one virtual repository may list (R-REPO-017).

upstream_accounts.description: Accounts of the repositories of the built-in project upstream (the presets and scanner-trivy), keyed by the repository's key (R-REPO-077). Each entry names auth_mode (basic, the default, or bearer), username_file (basic only) and password_file, absolute paths read at every use and never at load, and secret_name, the Kubernetes Secret the admin page names. quader migrate applies the map: it removes an account an administrator stored and records the change; the API and the UI show the account read-only. A missing, empty or unreadable file fails that repository's fetches with 502 upstream_secret_unavailable and stops no role. In the chart, secrets.upstreamAccounts renders this map. As an environment variable the map is JSON, for example QUADER_REPOSITORIES_UPSTREAM_ACCOUNTS='{"docker-hub":{"username_file":"/run/secrets/docker-hub/username","password_file":"/run/secrets/docker-hub/password"}}'.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Container memory limit; 0 means none known.

memory_limit_ratio.description: Share of the container memory limit given to the Go runtime.

active_key_id.description: Key ID used for encryption; every listed key decrypts.

encryption_key_files.description: Key files: 32 random bytes, base64; the file name without .key is the key ID.

base_url.description: Canonical external origin; empty is allowed for development only.

content_base_url.description: Separate content origin (P1); empty means one origin.

content_url_ttl.description: Lifetime of a signed content URL.

endpoints.description: Further endpoints by name (R-EP-001): each needs listen and base_url. The entry default may set only hosts, wildcard_host, host_roots, surface, auth, exposure, cache_fill, rate_limit_class and replica_header.

forwarded_header.description: The one header family the edge rewrites: X-Forwarded-* or Forwarded (RFC 7239). The other is never read.

ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the CA the links between quader's pods verify against, and that a client certificate of the scanner's listener and of the scan listener must chain to (R-ARCH-038). Read again every server.tls.reload_interval. The chart sets /var/run/secrets/quader/tls/ca.crt, the ca.crt of the pod's own Secret (R-HA-063). Needs server.tls.certificates: without TLS the links are plain HTTP.

listen.description: Client listener: UI, API, package protocols.

certificates.description: With inherit false: the ops listener's certificate/key pairs; empty means plain HTTP, allowed only while server.tls is plain too.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: With inherit false: client certificates on the ops listener; probes present none, so require breaks HTTPS probes.

client_ca_file.description: With inherit false: CAs a client certificate on the ops listener must chain to.

inherit.description: true: the ops listener serves server.tls's certificates, min_version and reload_interval without client certificates; false: the keys below are its own block.

min_version.description: With inherit false: lowest TLS version of the ops listener.

reload_interval.description: With inherit false: reload interval of the ops listener's files.

scan_clients.description: The names of the kinds of pod the scan listener admits: a client certificate of internal_tls.ca_file must list one of them exactly among its DNS names, no wildcard standing for it (R-ARCH-038, Q-ARCH-552). Required while scan_listen is open with TLS, except in the role all, where empty lets the CA alone admit (Q-ARCH-553). The chart sets the name of every kind of scanner it renders, [<fullname>-vuln-scanner-trivy.<namespace>.svc, <fullname>-malware-scanner-clamav.<namespace>.svc]; a route of the listener may narrow it to one of them.

scan_listen.description: The scan listener of a packages process (and web and all): the image scanning's pull, with scan tokens only, behind a client certificate of internal_tls.ca_file (R-ARCH-037). Empty opens none; the chart sets :8082 on the main packages Deployment while the image scanning is on.

send_buffer.description: SO_SNDBUF of every connection of the client listeners; the kernel doubles it for its bookkeeping, and the memory guard charges the doubled value to each request (Q-ARCH-500). 0 leaves the kernel's autotuning, charged at the most it may grow to (net.ipv4.tcp_wmem).

shutdown_timeout.description: Bound for in-flight requests and running work at SIGTERM. 0 derives it: runtime.termination_grace_period minus health.shutdown_drain_delay minus 5 s, or 25 s when the grace period is unknown. An explicit value must fit the grace period.

certificates.description: Certificate/key pairs (PEM). SNI selects the pair whose names match, wildcard certificates included; the first pair is the default. Empty means plain HTTP.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: none: no client certificate is requested; verify_if_given: a presented certificate must chain to client_ca_file; require: a client without one is refused in the handshake.

client_ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the CAs a client certificate must chain to (mutual TLS for the edge). Required unless client_auth is none.

min_version.description: Lowest TLS version accepted; TLS 1.3 is preferred either way.

reload_interval.description: How often every file of the block is read and compared by content. A changed certificate serves new handshakes within this interval.

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDRs of the edge that sets the forwarding header. A /0 prefix is refused.

anchors.description: Trust anchors declared here, keyed by the anchor's key (R-SIG-018): quader migrate applies them with the scope configuration in one transaction, creates what is declared, removes what is no longer declared, and stops with the key and the reason when the material fails the checks of R-SIG-015. The API and the UI show them read-only. Each entry names title, kind and exactly the block of its kind (ca, openpgp, public_key, sigstore); material is given inline or as a file (certificates_file, keys_file, pem_file, trusted_root_file), never both. The material is public: no private key is accepted. In the chart, signatures.anchors renders this map. As an environment variable the map is JSON, for example QUADER_SIGNATURES_ANCHORS='{"company-ca":{"title":"Company CA","kind":"ca","ca":{"certificates_file":"/etc/quader/signature-anchors/company-ca/certificates.pem"}}}'.

check_timeout.description: The longest one check may take; a check past it spends an attempt, and after the last attempt the signature is failed (R-SIG-013).

concurrency.description: Checks the one job of the installation has in flight at a time (R-SIG-011). At least 1: with none no signature would ever be checked.

enabled.description: false: no signature is detected, checked or shown with a badge; the stored rows stay as they are and are used again when the switch is turned back on (R-SIG-040).

download_wait.description: How long a download from a repository that serves only artifacts with a verified signature waits for the checks of its signatures (and the background fetch of a remote), counted from the request's arrival (R-SIG-067); then 503 signature_check_pending with Retry-After. One wait shared with a pending malware scan of the same request; the default keeps the answer inside apt's 30-second timeout.

max_waiting.description: Downloads one replica holds waiting for the checks of their signatures; a further one is answered 503 signature_check_pending at once (R-SIG-067).

preview_limit.description: Rows or items one preview of a repository's gate or one impact count of a change of anchors reads; beyond it the answer says complete: false and its counts are lower bounds (R-SIG-071, R-SIG-072).

refusals_retention.description: How long a download a gate refused stays in the list of refused downloads after its last refusal; the discovery step of the job signature-verify removes older rows (R-SIG-073).

max_attempts.description: Attempts at a check that could not run (the object store, a timeout), with a doubling back-off from one minute; after the last the signature is failed, and the discovery of the task signature-verify makes it due once a day (R-SIG-011).

max_chain.description: Certificates in one chain, each of at most 16 KiB; a longer chain is malformed with limits_exceeded (R-SIG-013).

max_content_size.description: Largest content a keyless scheme or a NuGet signature reads to compare its digest, streamed from the blob store and never written to disk; larger content leaves the signature unsupported with limits_exceeded (R-SIG-013).

max_object_size.description: Largest signature object that is read; a larger one is not read and is malformed with limits_exceeded (R-SIG-013). At most 1MiB: every real signature seen is below 20 KiB, and the worker that reads them holds the installation's secrets (H-1166).

max_per_subject.description: Signatures read per subject and repository; the rest is not read, and the details say how many of how many were read (R-SIG-013).

max_manifests_per_subject.description: OCI signature and attestation manifests fetched per image in the background, signature types first (R-SIG-026); each GET of one counts against the upstream's pull limit where the upstream has one. 0 fetches none.

refresh_after.description: An image's signatures are asked for again when a client's revalidation finds its tag unchanged and the last fetch is older than this, so a signature added upstream after the image was cached arrives within this span of use (R-SIG-026).

requests_per_hour.description: Background requests for signatures one replica sends to one remote per hour; what is above it waits for the next hour (R-SIG-026, H-1173). A client's own requests do not count.

run_slice.description: How long one job keeps its slot on the queue signatures before the rest of the work goes to the next job; a check in flight is finished first (R-SIG-011).

refresh.description: true: the task signature-trust-root fetches the public Sigstore trusted root and npm's registry keys from url once a day, verified from the TUF root embedded in the release. false: the release's snapshot holds and ages with the release (H-1170); QuaderSignatureTrustRootStale fires 14 days after the release was built.

url.description: The TUF repository the task reads, through the outbound client and its egress rules: the public one, or a TUF mirror of the company for an installation without internet. https only: the chain is verified from the embedded TUF root either way, and TLS keeps the request and its answer private.

enabled.description: false: Quader makes no receipt attestation; npm's registry signatures go on, and the attestations made before stay stored and served (R-SIG-053).

fills.description: false: only uploads are attested, not the artifacts a remote repository caches, for an installation whose remotes cache more than it wants to sign (R-SIG-053).

wait_for_checks.description: How long a new attestation waits for its item's first verdicts (the malware scan, the vulnerability evaluation, the checks of the signatures attached at the commit) before it is made with what there is, a pending state signed as such (R-SIG-053).

concurrency.description: Signing operations the one job of the installation has in flight at a time (R-SIG-049).

enabled.description: false: Quader signs nothing, also with an identity; the job signing takes no work, the identities stay manageable, and what is stored stays and is served (R-SIG-058).

announce_period.description: How long a new identity beside the current one is listed at npm's keys endpoint before it signs, so that a cache of the keys document learns the key before a signature made with it arrives (R-SIG-048). 0s: a new identity is current at once.

ca_file.description: PEM file of the root the chain ends in (ca.crt), when tls.crt does not end in it; it may hold intermediates too. Only with cert_file; the chart sets /var/run/secrets/quader/signing/ca.crt.

cert_file.description: PEM file of the identity's certificate and its intermediates, the leaf first (tls.crt of a cert-manager Secret). Empty: the identity comes from the admin area (R-SIG-047). While set, the identity of the files is the installation's: uploads and key requests are refused with 409 signing_identity_managed. The chart sets /var/run/secrets/quader/signing/tls.crt while signing.identity.existingSecret or signing.identity.certManager names one (R-HA-071).

key_file.description: PEM file of the identity's ECDSA P-256 private key (tls.key), unencrypted PKCS#8 or SEC 1. Read by the worker alone, held in its memory and never stored (R-SIG-046). Set with cert_file or not at all; the chart sets /var/run/secrets/quader/signing/tls.key.

reload_interval.description: How often a worker reads the three files again and compares their content (R-SIG-046): a pair cert-manager renewed is announced within this interval, without a restart (Q-SIG-151).

max_attempts.description: Attempts at an operation that could not run (the database, the object store), with a doubling back-off from one minute; after the last the work is failed, signing.failed is recorded once an hour per kind and code, and the job makes it due again once a day (R-SIG-049).

connections.description: The object-store connections, one to eight (R-STOR-050). The list order is the write order and the read order; every connection that is not draining holds every blob. An element without id is default, and at most one element may leave it out. In the environment the whole list is one JSON value (QUADER_STORAGE_CONNECTIONS).

batch_delete.description: Default true; false for a store without DeleteObjects.

bucket_file.description: A file whose trimmed content is the bucket; excludes bucket.

ca_file.description: The connection's trust anchor; empty means the outbound trust store.

drain.description: Takes the connection out: no upload goes to it, its blobs are copied to the others and then deleted here (R-STOR-051).

encrypted.description: Quader encrypts every blob of the connection in its own format and keeps the keys, so the provider sees ciphertext only (R-STOR-075); fixed once the connection holds data.

endpoint.description: Empty means AWS endpoint resolution for the region; a host without a scheme means https://.

endpoint_file.description: A file whose trimmed content is the endpoint (a provisioner's Secret), read once at start; excludes endpoint.

force_path_style.description: True for SeaweedFS, MinIO and Ceph RGW.

id.description: Names the connection for its whole life; default for at most one element, never changes, never reused.

keyed_names.description: Default true on an encrypted connection: object names are a keyed MAC of the digest (R-STOR-086); refused on a connection that is not encrypted; fixed once the connection holds data.

prefix.description: Default quader; fixed once the connection holds data (R-STOR-051).

region_file.description: A file whose trimmed content is the region; excludes region.

scrub_bytes_per_second.description: Default 50MiB, per connection and run; at least 1MiB.

scrub_period.description: Default 720h: every copy is read whole once in this period (R-STOR-027); at least 24h.

hold_back.description: Tail withheld until the digest matched; 0 would release corrupted bytes before the check (R-STOR-013).

delete_settle.description: Also bounds, as half of it, how long after its object write an upload may insert the blob row (R-STOR-005).

receive_window.description: HTTP/2 only: how far the store may send ahead of what Quader has read of one object; it bounds what a slow download holds (Q-ARCH-241). The transport's own default is 4 MiB.

startup_check.description: The start check of every connection before the first readiness, with its capabilities (R-STOR-035).

bytes_per_second.description: Streamed bytes per run; server-side copies are not counted.

concurrency.description: Copies at a time in one run.

queue_limit.description: Gaps the pass queues per connection before it waits for the copier.

run_duration.description: A run ends after this and the next scheduled run continues.

server_side.description: auto copies server-side between two connections on one endpoint.

min_copies.description: Copies written before an upload is answered; at most the number of connections without drain: true. The reconciliation brings a blob to the other connections afterwards.

run_duration.description: A run of the hourly task ends after this and the next continues.

max_bytes.description: Budget shared by all concurrent uploads of a replica; the chart derives it.

max_size.description: Largest upload; must fit spool.max_bytes on the roles web and all (a worker accepts no uploads).

max_open_sessions.description: Most open upload sessions one principal holds on one repository; a start above it answers 429 (R-STOR-011, Q-STOR-176).

writer_lease.description: Also the deadline of one part upload (below it): choose it above the time one part takes to send (R-STOR-011).

bootstrap_anonymous_read.description: Development only: true lets anonymous callers read /api/v1/system/info and /api/v1/system/replicas on the default endpoint while it admits anonymous requests. Refused while the base URL of an endpoint is an https origin other than localhost.

public_version.description: Expose the version to unauthenticated callers.

allow_insecure.description: Lets spans go to the collector in plaintext (an http:// endpoint, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE=true). Span metadata crosses the network unencrypted and unauthenticated; for a collector reached over loopback or a mesh sidecar only (INV-20).

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the collector. Refused with an http:// endpoint, where it would have no effect.

endpoint.description: Collector endpoint, e.g. https://otel-collector.observability:4318. https unless allow_insecure is true. Without user information: credentials go into headers_file.

incoming_context.description: trusted_peers: continue an incoming traceparent only from tracing.trusted_peers; all: from every client; none: never. A context that is not continued becomes a span link.

trusted_peers.description: Addresses or CIDRs of peers that set a trace context Quader may continue (a mesh sidecar, an internal caller). Empty: every request starts a new trace. Never the edge proxy, which passes the client's header through.

token_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable that snippets with credentials=env read the token from.

token_ttl.description: Lifetime the setup dialog asks for when it creates a token; at most auth.tokens.pat.max_ttl.

max_upload_bytes.description: Largest file the UI uploads through the content route of a repository; a larger PUT is answered 413 before the body is read, and the deploy dialog refuses it before it starts. 0 is unlimited. Token clients upload through /files/ and are not bound by it (R-API-025, Q-UI-106).

de.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the English text stands in, or the page does not exist.

en.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the German text stands in, or the page does not exist.

de.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the English text stands in, or the page does not exist.

en.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the German text stands in, or the page does not exist.

external_image_origins.description: Exact https origins (https://host[:port], no path, no wildcard) whose images a README may show. Every other external image is shown as a link. The same list becomes the img-src of the UI's Content-Security-Policy.

max_source_bytes.description: Largest README source that is rendered; a longer one is cut and the answer says so.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed calls that open the circuit.

addresses.description: Sentinel host:port list; required in sentinel mode.

primary_name.description: Name in the Sentinels' monitor line; required in sentinel mode.

tls.description: Use valkey.tls for Sentinel connections too.

startup_answer_timeout.description: How long a starting replica holds its first readiness for Valkey's first answer, accepted or refused; without one it then becomes ready degraded (R-HA-008). 0 does not wait.

ca_file.description: Empty means the system roots (verify-full only); required with verify-ca.

server_name.description: Empty means the host name of each address.

enabled.description: false: no sync, no evaluation, no block and no client-audit mode local; the stored findings stay as they are.

enforcement.description: enforce refuses the downloads the findings block (R-VULN-015); report blocks nothing anywhere: the would-be blocks are counted in quader_vuln_downloads_blocked_total{mode="report"} and recorded with enforced false. The installation-wide override for an emergency and for measuring a policy before enforcing it.

max_rows.description: An export that would exceed this answers 422 export_too_large before anything is streamed.

resolved_retention.description: A resolved finding and its events are kept this long (400 days) after it resolved; the task vuln-findings-retention deletes older ones. A finding that is re-detected before that is kept. Go durations have no day unit.

binary.description: The analyser: the scanner runs the analysis and the detection with it (R-VULN-048). The default is where the chart's init container copies the binary of the analyser's own image (trivy.image, TRIVY_IMAGE of tools/versions.env) into the read-only volume trivy-bin of each scanner pod (R-HA-070); the release image carries no analyser. Read by the scanner only; the worker runs no tool.

concurrency.description: Calls to the scanner one job has in flight (R-VULN-041). The default scanner capacity is two replicas of one slot; a call above the capacity is put off with scanner_busy.

dir.description: The directory of the scanner pod's copy of the database: the loader of the kind trivy-db writes each database into <dir>/<64 hex digits of its layer's digest>, renamed into place only when it is complete, and keeps the newest and the one before it; the scanner of the kind trivy mounts it read-only and detects with the database a call names (R-VULN-049). The chart mounts the volume trivy-db there. Read by the role scanner only; the worker reads none of it.

dir_budget.description: The room of the databases' files in dir: the loader holds the sizes of a database's two files from the archive's headers before it writes a byte, and a database that does not fit beside the newest replaces it (detections answer database_loading meanwhile). The chart sets it to the volume's size, vulnScannerTrivy.database.sizeLimit (Q-HA-380, Q-VULN-209). Read by the loader of the kind trivy-db only.

image.description: The image of the database in that repository (R-OCI-002). Only aquasec/trivy-db is accepted while repository is upstream/scanner-trivy, whose include pattern admits that name only; another name is for a repository of an own project, for a registry that publishes the database under another name (ghcr.io: aquasecurity/trivy-db).

max_archive_size.description: Largest database layer accepted: its declared size is checked before it is fetched or read, and a larger one fails the run with archive_too_large. The worker's spool must hold the unpacked database plus headroom.

repository.description: The qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of the OCI repository the database comes from: the system repository upstream/scanner-trivy, a remote of mirror.gcr.io that is always private and only for the scanner, or a local or remote OCI repository of an own project, for an installation without the internet (R-VULN-044). Whoever may push to such a repository decides what the images are compared with.

timeout.description: Time limit of one run's fetch and check of the database's layer, and of one load of it by the loader of a scanner pod (R-VULN-049).

enabled.description: false: no image is scanned; a repository's images are not_covered. The findings stay as they are, and the chart renders no scanner.

max_attempts.description: Attempts at a scan that fails for a reason that may pass (a layer that has not arrived, an analyser that was killed, a scanner that was lost).

max_entries.description: Largest number of file entries in the layers of an image.

max_image_size.description: Largest image scanned, compressed, config and layers together. An analysis holds the image's size plus 64 MiB of the scanner's spool budget while it runs; the chart refuses a scanner spool budget (vulnScannerTrivy.spool.sizeLimit minus spool.headroom) below scanner.slots times this limit plus 64 MiB. A larger image shows scan_failed.

max_layers.description: Images with more layers are not scanned and show scan_failed.

max_uncompressed_size.description: Largest size the layers of an image may decompress to together; a larger image is treated as a decompression bomb.

memory_limit.description: Soft limit of the analyser's Go heap. The memory limit of the pod is the hard one: an image that passes the scanner's ends that pod's analysis (scanner_lost).

pull_timeout.description: The scanner's pull of one image through the scan listener, and the lifetime of its scan token (R-OCI-037). The worker's call has the deadline pull_timeout plus timeout plus 1m.

client_name.description: The name by which the scan listener knows the image scanner (the kind trivy): a scanner's report of itself is recorded as a replica of vuln-scanner-trivy only from a client certificate that lists it exactly among its DNS names (R-OPS-048, Q-OPS-223). It must be one of server.scan_clients when that list is set, and differ from malware.scan_listener.client_name. Empty: the scan listener records no image scanner (the role all, where no scanner pod runs). The chart sets <fullname>-vuln-scanner-trivy.<namespace>.svc.

server_name.description: The name the scanner requires in the scan listener's certificate, which must chain to server.internal_tls.ca_file and list it exactly among its DNS names (Q-ARCH-552); empty is the host of url. The chart sets <fullname>-packages.<namespace>.svc, the name of packages (R-HA-063). The names the scan listener admits are server.scan_clients.

url.description: The scan listener of packages, an origin: https://<fullname>-packages-scan.<namespace>.svc:8082 in the chart, which sets it. Required in a scanner and in the loader of its database (the kind trivy-db, R-VULN-049); the role all builds neither (Q-ARCH-563). The scanner reads no other address: a call cannot point it elsewhere.

run_slice.description: How long one job keeps its slot on the queue vuln before the rest of the work goes to the next job, so that an advisory sync gets its turn.

scan_delay.description: Delay before a new manifest is scanned, so that a pull of a remote image has brought its layers.

scan_dir.description: Local directory of the scanner's working files below its spool: the analyses and the detections. Empty (the default) is <storage.spool.dir>/imagescan, so the files lie on the volume whose budget counts them (Q-VULN-184): the compressed size of the image plus 64 MiB per analysis, 64 MiB per detection. Lost with the pod without harm. Read by the scanner only; the worker writes nothing of a scan to its disk.

client_name.description: The name the scanner's listener requires in a client certificate, listed exactly among its DNS names (Q-ARCH-552): the worker's. Required in a scanner while server.tls serves TLS; empty in the role all, where the CA alone admits (Q-ARCH-553). The chart sets <fullname>-worker.<namespace>.svc.

server_name.description: The name the worker requires in the scanner's certificate, which must chain to server.internal_tls.ca_file and list it exactly among its DNS names, no wildcard standing for it (Q-ARCH-552); empty is the host of url. The chart sets <fullname>-vuln-scanner-trivy.<namespace>.svc, the scanner's name (R-HA-063).

slots.description: Calls one scanner process runs at a time, analyses and detections together (Q-VULN-204); a call while every slot holds one is answered 503 scanner_busy. The chart checks the scanner's spool against it (Q-HA-318); more than one slot lets the calls of one pod reach each other (H-1037), so scale by replicas.

url.description: The scanner's listener, an origin: https://<fullname>-vuln-scanner-trivy.<namespace>.svc:8080 in the chart, which sets it. Required in a worker while the image scanning is on. The role all builds no image scanner (Q-ARCH-563): with it empty there, the image scanning's job ends at once with the result no image scanner is configured and touches no row; set, the role all calls the scanner at that address.

timeout.description: Time limit of one step of the analyser in the scanner: the analysis and the detection. The worker's call of a detection has the deadline timeout plus 1m (R-VULN-048).

public_upstreams.description: Per format ID, the hosts of the public registries. A remote repository whose upstream host is listed is matched with matchPublicAdvisories auto; any other remote is not_covered until it sets always. Replaces the whole map when set.

mode.description: Off, and only off is built in this release (P1). The operator who switches EPSS on decides whether the data's terms permit the installation's use: FIRST publishes the EPSS scores without a stated licence, its site reads "All Rights Reserved", and it asks for attribution in products that use the scores; Quader makes no statement about what that permits.

repository.description: Mode repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of a generic local repository.

url.description: The daily EPSS file; https only. Not fetched while mode is off.

mode.description: online, repository (kev/known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json in the mirror repository) or off; with off every known-exploited flag stays as it was last computed.

repository.description: Mode repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of a generic local repository.

base_url.description: The root of the OSV export bucket; https only. The sync requests <ecosystem>/all.zip, <ecosystem>/modified_id.csv and <ecosystem>/<id>.json below it, never the global archive.

ecosystems.description: OSV ecosystems to import. Empty: every ecosystem of a format that has the vulnerability adapter in this release (npm, NuGet). The list may only narrow that set; an ecosystem without an adapter is refused.

full_resync_threshold.description: Changed records above which an incremental run turns into a full one.

max_archive_size.description: Largest archive accepted. The worker's spool (worker.spool.sizeLimit) must hold one archive plus headroom.

max_record_size.description: Largest advisory record, in the archive uncompressed and fetched singly. A larger record is rejected and counted, and the run goes on (R-VULN-004, Q-VULN-116).

max_shrink.description: The share of an ecosystem's stored records a full sync may delete. A larger shrink fails the run with shrink_refused and changes nothing; a manual run with {"acceptShrink": true} overrides it once.

mode.description: online: the worker role fetches the per-ecosystem archives (R-VULN-004); repository: it reads them from a generic local repository of the installation, for an air-gapped installation (R-VULN-005); off: the stored data stays as it is and ages, and is never deleted by turning the source off.

overlap.description: Subtracted from the time a download started to set the watermark, because the exporter writes the archive and the change file at different times (Q-VULN-11).

repository.description: Mode repository: the qualified name <projectKey>/<repoKey> of a generic local repository that holds osv/<ecosystem>/all.zip (R-VULN-005). Whoever holds deploy on it decides the advisory data of the installation.

timeout.description: Timeout of one archive download; a record or a part of the change file has 30 s.

stale_after.description: An ecosystem whose last successful sync is older than this is stale: evaluation and enforcement continue on the stored data, the report shows a banner and the alert QuaderVulnerabilityDataStale fires. Staleness never affects readiness.

title: Quader configuration
